items.title: Michael Burry Ramped Up His Bets Against Micron and the QQQ ETF. Is the ‘Big Short’ Investor Asking for Trouble?
items.summary: Michael Burry is doubling down on bets against Micron and the QQQ even as those positions bleed, convinced a larger market collapse is coming. With Wall Street overwhelmingly on the other side, the question is whether he is a contrarian genius or a cautionary tale in slow motion.

items.title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Caterpillar (CAT): Read This Before Placing a Bet
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Caterpillar (CAT) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: Global equity funds extend inflow streak as earnings optimism and reduced rate-hike bets lift sentiment
items.summary: Aug 14 () - Global equity funds attracted inflows for a 12th consecutive week through August 12, buoyed by optimism over a strong earnings ‌season and data showing weaker-than-expected U. payroll growth and easing inflation, ‌which tempered expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.title: Caterpillar's Falling Multiple Rests On Margin, Not Its Backlog
items.summary: Consensus already expects the revenue boom to fade, leaving margin to do much of the work of bringing the multiple down.

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like Caterpillar Stock?
items.summary: While Caterpillar has outperformed the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Trimble Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Field Systems Strength
items.summary: TRMB's Q2 earnings beat estimates as Field Systems' strength, recurring revenue growth and higher margins drive results and lift its 2026 outlook.

items.title: These nontech stocks can ride the AI build-out for years
items.summary: Massive spending on data centers and AI infrastructure can benefit “HALO” companies: hard assets, low obsolescence.

items.title: CAT Ends Q2 With Record Backlog: Is Demand Momentum Here to Stay?
items.summary: Caterpillar's record $72 billion backlog points to strong demand ahead, supporting its upgraded 2026 sales outlook and growth across key segments.
